description: This file defines the 'Mediator' class that manages interactions between trace data, viewers, remote tools, and UI components within a trace analysis application. It handles file processing, remote communication, timestamp updates, and viewer updates.

classes.name: Mediator
classes.description: Acts as a central coordinator for handling trace file processing, remote tool communication, viewer updates, and UI interactions within the trace analysis application.

methods.name: setUploadTracesComponent
methods.description: Sets the progress listener for trace uploads.

methods.name: setCollectTracesComponent
methods.description: Sets the progress listener for trace collection.

methods.name: setTimelineComponent
methods.description: Sets the listener for trace position updates on the timeline.

methods.name: onWinscopeInitialized
methods.description: Triggers when the application initializes; starts the extension functionality.

methods.name: onWinscopeUploadNew
methods.description: Resets application state to initial state upon new upload.

methods.name: onWinscopeFilesUploaded
methods.description: Processes files uploaded from the user.

methods.name: onWinscopeFilesCollected
methods.description: Processes collected trace files and prepares for visualization.

methods.name: onWinscopeViewTracesRequest
methods.description: Processes the request to view traces, ensuring they are loaded.

methods.name: onWinscopeTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates the trace position across viewers and remote tools.

methods.name: onBuganizerAttachmentsDownloadStart
methods.description: Handles initiation of buganizer attachments download, resetting state.

methods.name: onBuganizerAttachmentsDownloaded
methods.description: Handles completion of buganizer attachment downloads, processing remote files.

methods.name: onRemoteBugreportReceived
methods.description: Processes remote bug report files and optional timestamp.

methods.name: onRemoteTimestampReceived
methods.description: Handles timestamp updates received from remote tools, updating trace position.

methods.name: processRemoteFilesReceived
methods.description: Resets state and processes remote files received asynchronously.

methods.name: processFiles
methods.description: Unzips and parses trace files, and handles parser errors.

methods.name: processLoadedTraceFiles
methods.description: Finalizes trace data loading, updates UI, creates viewers, and applies remote timestamps if available.

methods.name: createViewers
methods.description: Creates visualization viewers based on trace types.

methods.name: updateViewersTracePosition
methods.description: Propagates updated trace position to all viewers.

methods.name: executeIgnoringRecursiveTimestampNotifications
methods.description: Prevents recursive timestamp updates by controlling a flag.

methods.name: resetAppToInitialState
methods.description: Resets all internal state and data, clearing traces and viewers.
